paper_record.title: Broadband emitter localization and prefabrication two-photon interference from InAs/InP quantum dots monolithically grown on an InGaAsP/InP distributed Bragg reflector
paper_record.abstract: We demonstrate a monolithic telecom C-band single-photon platform based on low-density InAs/InP quantum dots grown on an InGaAsP/InP distributed Bragg reflector, with simulated upward light-extraction efficiency exceeding 10% within the 40 nm spectral band. Enhanced light extraction is crucial for wide-field photoluminescence imaging, enabling approximately 3 nm statistical centroid-localization precision of QD emitters due to improved signal-to-noise ratio. The identified charged exciton emitting at 1549.5 nm exhibits single-photon emission purity up to 94.7%, validated by a raw peak-area integration under pulsed quasi-resonant excitation. Under these conditions, photons emitted sequentially from the unprocessed planar structure reveal a raw two-photon interference visibility of 51% of the photon wave packet within the 2 ns time window and 41% over a 4 ns integration window, all without Purcell enhancement typical for cavity-embedded emitters. Combining broadband extraction, high photon coherence, and emitter preselection on a native III-V wafer, this architecture paves the way for marker-based deterministic fabrication of high-quality monolithic nanophotonic devices.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文展示了一种基于生长在分布式布拉格反射镜（DBR）上的低密度 InAs/InP 量子点的单片电信 C 波段单光子平台，实现了宽带光提取、纳米级定位以及高纯度与相干性的单光子发射。
one_sentence_summary.en: This work demonstrates a monolithic telecom C-band single-photon platform based on low-density InAs/InP quantum dots grown on a distributed Bragg reflector, achieving broadband photon extraction, nanometer-scale localization, and high-purity, coherent single-photon emission.

problem.zh: 如何在未加工的平面结构中克服电信 C 波段自组装量子点发射源提取效率低、空间定位困难且光子相干性不足的问题，以满足可扩展量子光学的需求。
problem.en: How to overcome low photon extraction efficiency, spatial localization challenges, and insufficient photon coherence in unprocessed planar telecom C-band self-assembled quantum dot sources for scalable quantum optics.

approach.zh: 采用金属有机化学气相沉积（MOVPE）单片生长低密度 InAs/InP 量子点于 InGaAsP/InP 分布式布拉格反射镜（DBR）上，结合宽带光致发光成像进行空间定位，并通过汉堡-布朗-特温斯（HBT）及洪-欧-曼德尔（HOM）干涉测量评估光子统计与相干性。
approach.en: Monolithically growing low-density InAs/InP quantum dots on an InGaAsP/InP distributed Bragg reflector using MOVPE, combining wide-field photoluminescence imaging for spatial localization, and evaluating photon statistics and coherence via HBT and HOM interferometry.

main_takeaway.zh: 在无腔增强的平面单片 DBR 结构中，InAs/InP 量子点在 1549.5 nm 处实现了高达 0.059 的多光子抑制以及在 2 ns 窗口内 51% 的原始双光子干涉可见度，同时支持约 3 nm 的质心定位精度。
main_takeaway.en: In a cavity-free planar monolithic DBR structure, InAs/InP quantum dots achieve a low multiphoton probability with a raw g(2)(0) of 0.059 at 1549.5 nm and a raw HOM visibility of 51% within a 2 ns window, while enabling statistical centroid localization precision of about 3 nm.

why_it_matters.zh: 该平台将宽带光提取、纳米级定位与高光子相干性无缝集成于单个外延晶圆中，为未来确定性制造高性能电信波段单片纳米光子器件奠定了坚实的基础。
why_it_matters.en: This platform seamlessly integrates broadband extraction, nanometer-scale localization, and high photon coherence within a single epitaxial wafer, laying a solid foundation for the future deterministic fabrication of high-performance telecom-band monolithic nanophotonic devices.

reason.zh: 该研究在无微腔 Purcell 增强的平面结构中展示了优异的电信 C 波段光子相干性与宽带提取能力，为可扩展的确定性量子光源集成开辟了新途径。
reason.en: The study demonstrates exceptional telecom C-band photon coherence and broadband extraction in a planar structure without microcavity Purcell enhancement, opening a new path for scalable deterministic quantum light source integration.

reason.zh: 该工作在电信 C 波段量子光源的单片集成、宽带提取和光子全波包相干性方面取得了突破性进展，符合该期刊的高影响力标准。
reason.en: The work achieves breakthrough progress in monolithic integration, broadband extraction, and full-wavepacket photon coherence for telecom C-band quantum light sources, fitting the high-impact standards of this journal.
